description: Growth since any date: how many MCP servers were first published on or after it, split by namespace type. Good for 'How many new MCP servers since October?'. Example: new_servers_count_since(date="2026-10-01") -> {since, count, by_namespace_type}. Date format YYYY-MM-DD. The date is optional: with no arguments it counts the last 30 days up to the snapshot date.

date.description: Date as YYYY-MM-DD, for example "2026-10-01". Optional: empty means the last 30 days up to the snapshot date.
date.title: Date

name: new_servers_count_since
